newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open at all-time high on Dow jump.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open at all-time high on Dow jump.

text.p: UK shares roared to an all-time trading high on Friday, spurred on by Wall Street's 127-point rally overnight, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares open 45.1 points higher at 4,096.4, surpassing the previous peak of 4,073.1 set on November 26.
UK shares open at all-time record high on Dow =2
"The Dow's jump overnight was unbelievable. It certainly has given the market a boost in confidence," one senior dealer said.
"The only question now is how high the FTSE will go."
The Dow industrials average soared 126.87 points to close at 6,473.64, the second biggest net gain in U.S. history.
The FTSE retreated from its highs within the first 15 minutes of trade, however, as once again the 4,100 barrier encouraged some light selling, dealers said.
"The air becomes a bit rarified above 4,100," one technical analyst said.
